content.summary: Project coordination specialist with 5 years of experience supporting donor-funded community programmes, vendor delivery, procurement tracking, and practical stakeholder reporting.

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated delivery plans for 14 community projects, maintaining 96% on-time milestone completion.
Prepared monthly budget and procurement trackers for TZS 2.4 billion in programme activity.
Facilitated review meetings with 26 partner organisations, resolving 41 delivery risks before escalation.

experience.title: Programme Assistant
bullets: Maintained grant documentation for 9 regional programmes, improving audit-file completeness to 99%.
Created bilingual field-report templates that reduced monthly reporting turnaround by 30%.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Development Studies
